svg.title: F30-4 Dataset 5: CDU-07 temperature sensors against a reference (example data)
svg.text: F30-4 Dataset 5: CDU-07 temperature sensors against a reference (example data)
reference logger ±0.1 K · TT-03 error within ±0.1 K · TT-01 drifts 0.05 K per day from day 4 and passes the +0.5 K limit on day 13 · TT-02 frozen at 45.2 °C from day 9
• TT-01 error rises from 0.05 K to 0.55 K; it passes 0.5 K on day 13 (24 h mean 0.52 K on day 14).
• TT-01 is recalibrated or replaced before the L4 test.
• TT-02 reads 45.2 °C with zero variation from hour 216; the stuck-value rule flags it at hour 222.
